items.text: – Dhagaa marmalii ti. Marmaliin jechuun baay'ee qaalii jechuu dha.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'marmalii' a natural child's slip of 'marmarii', still recognizable?
before: Ammas deemna turre. Gidduu karaatti mana tokkotu ture. Dallaan ishee bareedaa ture. Qaasim ni jedha ture:
